items.basis: Re-verified NOT shipped this sweep (Jul 19, 6PM): DeepMind's model page still reads '3.5 Pro coming soon' and it is absent from the Artificial Analysis leaderboard. Recurring 'Jul 17 launch' blog claims stay unsourced SEO churn.

Polymarket's dated GPT-6 market prices ~67.5% by Dec 31 and ~39.5% by Sep 30 (under 2% this month); OpenAI's line still flows through the GPT-5.6 family, keeping the numbered flagship a late-2026 story.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; Polymarket prices a next Claude Opus at ~98-99% by Oct 31, version unannounced.
xAI shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; markets price Grok 5 single-digit near-term. The 6T V9-foundation model is reportedly still training on Colossus 2, with public access likely slipping to Q3+.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is reportedly targeted for Jul 24 2026 per DeepSeek's developer notes — five days out.
